mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rates above 6% triggers bearish investor sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE exceeding 6.0% in the trigger period, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant negative relationship.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing activity (HOUST) signal robust economic momentum, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to outperform baseline when both GDPC1 and HOUST show upward trends simultaneously, or IC <0.03 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (rising FEDFUNDS), higher interest rates reduce the present value of future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 0.5% in the trigger period, or IC >0.03 over the tightening phase.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the production index (INDPRO) reflects strong supply-side growth, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to show significant positive correlation with INDPRO trends (p >0.05), or IC <0.03 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden jump in employment numbers (PAYEMS) above 140,000 in a month triggers optimism about labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain non-positive despite PAYEMS exceeding 140,000, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant positive relationship.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in GDP growth (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand, enhancing corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to outperform baseline when both GDPC1 and RSAFS show upward trends, or IC <0.03 over the period.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by low unemployment (UNRATE <4.0%) and robust GDP growth (GDPC1 >12,000), investors anticipate peak rates and position for equity gains, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns fail to show significant positive correlation with the late-cycle expansion regime (IC <0.03), or returns remain non-positive despite the regime conditions being met.
